moments.title: Commonwealth Games in Full Swing
moments.blurb: The Glasgow 2026 Commonwealth Games are currently underway, bringing together athletes from 74 nations and territories for 11 days of competition across Glasgow.

angles.name: General Update
angles.copy: The Commonwealth Games are dominating Glasgow right now! Who are you cheering for? #CommonwealthGames2026

angles.name: Scottish Focus
angles.copy: Glasgow is buzzing as the Commonwealth Games continue! Scotland's biggest city is alive with sporting action until August 2nd.

moments.title: Zelensky Meets New UK PM
moments.blurb: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky is in London today to meet the new UK Prime Minister, Andy Burnham, for discussions on the ongoing conflict.

angles.name: National News
angles.copy: Major talks in London today as President Zelensky meets with the new UK Prime Minister. Key discussions expected on the Ukraine-Russia conflict.

moments.title: AIG Women's Open Tees Off
moments.blurb: The AIG Women's Open golf championship begins on Wednesday, July 29th, at Royal Lytham and St Annes, running until August 2nd.

angles.name: Golf Excitement
angles.copy: Get ready for world-class golf! The AIG Women's Open tees off this Wednesday at Royal Lytham and St Annes. Who's your pick for the trophy?

moments.title: Cowes Week Sets Sail
moments.blurb: The iconic Cowes Week sailing regatta kicks off on Saturday, August 1st, bringing a week of competitive racing and festivities to the Isle of Wight.

angles.name: Sailing Spectacle
angles.copy: Ahoy there! Cowes Week begins this Saturday, August 1st. Get ready for a spectacular week of sailing on the Solent!

moments.title: Belladrum Tartan Heart Festival
moments.blurb: Scotland's Belladrum Tartan Heart Festival runs from July 30th to August 1st, featuring headliners James, The Human League, and Callum Beattie.

angles.name: Festival Line-up
angles.copy: Belladrum Tartan Heart Festival kicks off this Thursday! Ready for James, The Human League & Callum Beattie in the Highlands?

moments.title: Y-Not Festival Rocks Derbyshire
moments.blurb: Y-Not Festival returns to Derbyshire from July 30th to August 2nd, with The Libertines, Reytons, Two Door Cinema Club, and The Streets leading the lineup.

angles.name: Indie Festival Vibes
angles.copy: Y-Not Festival is back this Thursday! Who's excited for The Libertines, The Streets & more in the Peak District?

moments.title: Camp Bestival Dorset Begins

source.l: Ticketmaster / We're Going On An Adventure

angles.name: Family Festival Fun
angles.copy: Camp Bestival Dorset kicks off Thursday! Bastille, Fatboy Slim, Billy Ocean & more for a weekend of family fun at Lulworth Castle.

moments.title: Wilderness Festival Opens
moments.blurb: Wilderness Festival in Oxfordshire starts on July 30th, running until August 2nd, with headliners Scissor Sisters, Carl Cox, and The Last Dinner Party.

angles.name: Boutique Festival Vibes
angles.copy: Wilderness Festival is just days away! Scissor Sisters, Carl Cox & The Last Dinner Party are set to ignite Oxfordshire this weekend.

moments.title: Grace Jones at Palace Bowl Presents
moments.blurb: The legendary Grace Jones performs at Palace Bowl Presents in London on Friday, July 31st, with special guests Sophie Ellis-Bextor and Soul II Soul.

angles.name: Iconic Performance
angles.copy: Grace Jones, Sophie Ellis-Bextor, and Soul II Soul – what a lineup! Catch them at Palace Bowl Presents this Friday, July 31st.

moments.title: Gary Numan in Halifax

angles.name: Synth-Rock Legend
angles.copy: Gary Numan brings his iconic synth-rock sound to The Piece Hall in Halifax this Friday! Don't miss out.

moments.title: Singles Chart Showdown
moments.blurb: Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' is battling to become the longest-running UK Number 1 by a British act, while Shakira and Burna Boy's 'Dai Dai' is hot on its heels in the latest UK Official Singles Chart for the week ending July 25th.

angles.name: Chart Race
angles.copy: Can 'Rein Me In' make history? Sam Fender & Olivia Dean are fighting for the longest-running UK No.1! Plus, Shakira & Burna Boy are close behind.

angles.name: Pop Hits
angles.copy: The latest chart is in! Olivia Rodrigo, Oasis, and Taylor Swift (from Toy Story 5!) are all in the mix. What's your current favourite?

moments.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day Hits Cinemas
moments.blurb: Tom Holland returns as Peter Parker in 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day', swinging into UK cinemas on Wednesday, July 29th.

angles.name: Film Release
angles.copy: Your friendly neighbourhood Spider-Man is back! 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' with Tom Holland hits cinemas this Wednesday.

moments.title: Wallace & Gromit Re-release

angles.name: Family Film Fun
angles.copy: Cracking good news! Wallace & Gromit's 'The Curse of the Were-Rabbit' is back in cinemas this Friday! Perfect for some nostalgic family fun.
